intro: Oil makes up most of the Republic of the Congo's exports.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Offshore oil, timber and potash are major products. Heavy debts have caused economic problems.

chapters.title: Forest
text: Timber is exported, and peatlands store huge amounts of carbon.

cardGroups.title: Made in Congo
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things the Republic of the Congo makes and sells to the world.
